D00.justification: RDD D00 is defined as longitudinal crack. Direct 1:1 mapping.

D10.justification: RDD D10 is defined as transverse crack. Direct 1:1 mapping.

D20.justification: RDD D20 is alligator (crocodile) cracking. Direct 1:1 mapping.

D40.justification: RDD D40 is pothole. Direct 1:1 mapping.

D50.justification: RDD D44 is 'crosswalk blur'. Mapped to TariqMap D50 (faded pedestrian crossing) only when D44 annotations exist. Not invented from unlabeled pothole photos.

D60.justification: RDD D43 is 'white line blur'. Mapped to TariqMap D60 (faded lane marking) only when D43 annotations exist.

D90.description: Visual rutting / ornieriage (no depth measurement from 2D image)
D90.justification: ABSENT from RDD2022/RDD2024. Do not map any RDD class to D90. Do not train a D90 head until a labeled rutting source exists.
D90.limitation: 2D image cannot measure rut depth — severity is visual only. Class is taxonomy-only until labeled data exists.

_exclusion_policy: Any source class not listed above MUST be written to the exclusion report. Do NOT silently merge unknown classes. RDD 'D50' (other damage, some country subsets) is NOT TariqMap D50 — exclude it.

_unmapped_rdd_classes.D50_rdd_other: Some RDD country subsets use D50 as a catch-all 'other' class. That is not faded-crossing. Exclude.
_unmapped_rdd_classes.D90: Not present in RDD. Do not hallucinate boxes or remap D40 potholes to rutting.
